items.description: Pastes the internal clipboard into a target range with paste-special semantics: selectable content (values / formulas / formats / all / all-except-borders), an optional arithmetic operation against the existing target values, skip-blanks, and transpose. Relative formula references are shifted by the paste offset (except when transposing, where formulas are flattened to their computed value to avoid producing wrong references). Undo restores the overwritten cells exactly.

members.name: AffectedCellRefs
members.description: The cell references changed by the latest paste (for renderer invalidation).

items.description: Removes duplicate rows from a range, keeping the first occurrence of each distinct key-column combination and compacting the surviving rows upward within the range. Only the columns inside the range are touched (Excel/OnlyOffice semantics); cells outside the range stay put. The whole operation is a single atomic step: Undo restores the original layout exactly. Ranges that intersect a merged cell are rejected.

Replaces matched text within a single cell and supports undo. The cell's searchable text (displayed value or formula, per SearchIn) is rewritten and re-parsed through SpreadsheetValueParser. In Values mode formula cells are skipped so their formulas are never destroyed.

items.description: Sets the width of a column and supports undo.
Sets the height of a row and supports undo.

Turns the auto-filter on over a range (or moves it to a new range). Enabling the filter adds the header buttons but hides nothing until column criteria are set. Undo restores the previous filter and the previous row visibility.
Applies a style mutation to multiple cells and supports undo.

Sets the value and/or formula of a single cell and supports undo. Optionally applies a typed data type and an implied number format (the latter only when the cell still uses the General format), as produced by SpreadsheetValueParser.
Adds or replaces a data validation rule on a sheet range. Fully undoable: removes any previous rule that overlapped the same range and restores it on undo.
Sets a structured hyperlink on a cell. If the cell is empty and a display text is provided, the display text is written into the cell value. Supports undo.

Sorts a range by reordering whole rows (or columns when ByRows is set). Cell values, formulas and styles move with their row; relative formula references are shifted by the row delta of the move so they keep pointing at the same logical data. Undo restores the original cell layout exactly. Ranges that intersect merged cells are rejected.

examples.title: Basic spreadsheet
examples.code:
<TmSpreadsheet Height="500px"
               RowsCount="100"
               ColumnsCount="20"
               OnChange="HandleChange" />

@code {
    private void HandleChange(SpreadsheetChangeEventArgs args)
        => Console.WriteLine($"{args.CellRef} = {args.NewValue}");
}

examples.title: Load and export an XLSX workbook
examples.code:
<TmSpreadsheet @ref="_sheet" Data="@_xlsxBytes" />

<TmButton OnClick="DownloadAsync">Download</TmButton>

@code {
    private TmSpreadsheet? _sheet;
    private byte[]? _xlsxBytes;

    private async Task DownloadAsync()
    {
        var bytes = await _sheet!.ExportToExcelAsync();
        // hand the bytes to your download helper
    }
}

examples.title: Read-only view and programmatic edits
examples.code:
<TmSpreadsheet @ref="_sheet" Mode="SpreadsheetMode.Full" />

@code {
    private TmSpreadsheet? _sheet;

    protected override void OnAfterRender(bool firstRender)
    {
        if (!firstRender) return;
        _sheet!.SetCellValue("A1", "Total");
        _sheet.SetCellValue("B1", "=SUM(B2:B10)");
    }
}
